summary: Manager, Risk and Compliance Transformation candidate for KPMG's Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) practice, bringing roughly 7 years across financial-institution risk governance, regulatory transformation, and advisory delivery. Delivered IFRS 17/IFRS 9 governance documentation and regulatory-readiness work for Canadian insurers at EY, including go-to-market collateral supporting practice business development. Currently a member of Moody's Analytics' model governance committee, holding delegated sign-off on analytics for institutional portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement) - independent review, documentation, and escalation discipline transferable to enterprise risk and compliance frameworks. CFA, dual MSc; working proficiency in Python, SQL, and agentic-AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor).
core_skills: Risk Framework Design (ALM/Investment) & Independent Model Review
AI Platforms & Agentic Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor)
Data Analytics - Python, SQL, Advanced Excel

sections.heading: Risk Governance & Independent Review
bullets: Member of the model governance committee - contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), performing independent review and challenge before production release.

Operate within a formal governance framework - validating assumptions, assessing economic defensibility, and building governance documentation and auditability standards consistent with model risk management guidance (OSFI E-23 / SR 11-7 style).
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic support and act as escalation point for client-critical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Risk Technology, AI & Data Analytics
bullets: Built agentic AI workflows on AI platforms (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation - reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet processes into scalable Python data-analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and audit controls.
Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across ALM horizons.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Reporting & Client Delivery
bullets: Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholder audiences on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities - translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.

Led onboarding and implementation across multiple client engagements for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM platforms.
Scoped client requirements into Product Owner development requests and migrated all assigned accounts off the legacy Calypso platform, validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation engagements for Canadian and international insurance clients - aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on standard adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory readiness processes for financial institutions.
Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral supporting practice business development.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and PM teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.
Designed stochastic risk-management frameworks tailored to specific client mandates for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors.
Delivered ALM and liability-driven investment studies analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk under base-case and stressed environments.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.
Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger - on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics.
